title: The Numbered Man
author: Barış Kısır
premise: Accountant Elias Vane lives by numbers: his day is a ledger, his home a balance sheet. When a stranger hands him a numbered slip — "You are #712" — and people around him begin dying in numerical order, Elias must audit the last seventy-two hours of his life to find the man who is counting him down.
